answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 entry slots; a newcomer must win one with a sunk 50 POA bid. The bid is burned, idle slots are revoked after 3 epochs, and a cheat loses its slot plus 30 POA, sending a ripple to its sponsor as well. Jobs from harvesting saffron to cutting quartz are logged against the bid. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA sunk plus 30,000 POA in penalties. An honest agent pays one bid and keeps its slot, because every entry into paid work passes through the same auction.
